text:
Maya C: quick intake from SouthBridge Retail — they want a custom multilingual product-description model (EN/ES/FR). asking for: embeddings + concise product generation + reranker. target model: quantized 13B if compatible with our runtimes. timeline: pilot in ~3 weeks, prod in 10–12 weeks. not PHI, but contains price-sensitive and spec-heavy content. can we run hallucination/safety evals focused on pricing and spec accuracy?
Samir R: thanks — couple q's: do they have a labeled eval set for specs/price? or just product copy corpus?
Maya C: they have ~40k product records + 2k annotated spec-accuracy checks (internal). can request a small additional eval set from them.
Asha L: I'll book a 30m kickoff with their PM and data lead. prefer Wed AM PST — adding enablement checklist (quick demo, API keys, sample prompts).
Jonas K: heads up — quantized 13B on VPC might require compatibility testing for their tokenization (multilang). pinging eng-ml for tokenization/embedding parity across languages.
Elena P: flagging renewal risk: account is mid-contract, next renewal in 9 months. success here is a big expansion opportunity. capture usage KPIs and joint success metrics (latency, hallucination rate, rerank accuracy).
Samir R: for safety evals I'll draft a short prompt suite: pricing hallucination tests, spec-extraction F1, and cross-lingual consistency checks. need customer agreement to run test prompts against staging data.
Maya C: noted — I'll ask for sample CSV + consent to run evals on staging. also confirm they want private (VPC) vs hosted — they said private for IP reasons but open to dedicated if easier.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-5789 — southbridge multilang model intake. Assignee: eng-ml. URL: https://redwood.atlassian.local/browse/CS-5789
Jonas K: assigning preliminary compatibility task to eng-ml-sprint: "tokenization + embedding parity (en/es/fr)" — ETA 5 business days.
Asha L: enablement items: 1) onboarding playbook, 2) prompt tuning session, 3) eval dashboard access. I'll draft a one-pager and sample prompts.
Samir R: also recommend we run a small canary with a safety filter (price regex + fallback) until reranker passes thresholds.
Elena P: please add renewal-tracking tag and include CSM success plan in the ticket (milestones + decision points).
Maya C: thanks team — next steps: I will 1) confirm VPC vs Dedicated with customer, 2) collect sample CSV + sign-off for evals, 3) schedule kickoff (Asha) — will update CS-5789 with links and timestamps. any blockers?
Jonas K: none from infra side yet. might surface if model quantization changes embedding shape.
Samir R: if they can share redacted price fields that will speed evals.
Asha L: scheduled kickoff for Wed 09:30 PST, invite sent to SouthBridge PM + data lead.
Maya C: perfect — will follow up after kickoff with a short checklist. :thumbsup:
